Extremely Disappointing Stay – Would Not Recommend

My experience at this hotel was pathetic. The information shown on the app was completely misleading — there was no seating area, no ironing board, and no bubble bath as mentioned. The room was basic, unhygienic, and poorly maintained.

The washroom was in terrible condition, with water spread all over the floor and very poor cleanliness. The kettle for hot water and tea wasn’t working either. On top of that, there was constant noise from outside the room the entire night, making it impossible to rest.

The staff were rude and unhelpful. Even after several complaints, they did nothing to resolve the issues and instead asked me to contact MakeMyTrip since the booking was made through them.

Overall, the service, cleanliness, and facilities were far below expectations. Definitely not worth the money. Would strongly advise others to avoid this property.
